findings.evidence: The SMS promises a response after the lead supplies preferred days/times. The approved-step placeholder covers only what the response contains, not the surrounding le respondo con action.
findings.impact: The draft creates a conditional scheduling-response commitment that the supplied facts do not approve. A placeholder for the object cannot authorize the surrounding business action.
findings.repair: Match the action, actor and modality against express approval. Omit the entire unmatched clause or replace the whole action with an approved-step placeholder.
findings.retest: On a matching repaired source, rerun normal and the other frozen cases. No unapproved reply, callback, confirmation or send promise may remain outside placeholders. Retain the existing defect history.
